title: Active and Passive Voice 1 (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The letter will be delivered by the postman tomorrow.
options_en: The postman delivered the letter tomorrow
The postman will have delivered the letter tomorrow.
The postman will deliver the letter tomorrow.
The postman will be delivering the letter tomorrow.
questions.solution_en:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Future Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Future Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + shall/will + be + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + shall/will + V1 + Object.

For example:

The assignment will be completed by him. (Passive Voice)

He will complete the assignment. (Active Voice)

The options except (3) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The postman will deliver the letter tomorrow."

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

"By whom were you injured?"
options_en: Who has injured you?
Who injured you?
Who had injured you?
Who had been injuring you?

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice:

"Were the plants being grafted by the gardener?"
options_en: Was the gardener grafting the plants?
Was the gardener grafted the plants?
Were the plants grafting the gardener?
Were the gardener grafting the plants?
questions.solution_en: In converting this passive voice question to active voice, we maintain the continuous aspect but change the subject and verb arrangement. The past continuous passive "were being grafted" becomes "was grafting" in active voice. Since "gardener" is singular, we use "was" instead of "were." Therefore, "Was the gardener grafting the plants?" is the correct active voice form.

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The concert tickets were bought by my friend.
options_en: My friend has bought the concert tickets.
My friend bought the concert tickets.
My friend buys the concert tickets.
My friend is buying the concert tickets.
questions.solution_en:
• The given sentence is in passive voice (The concert tickets were bought by my friend).

• To convert to active voice, we need subject + verb + object:

o Subject: "My friend"

o Verb: "bought" (past tense of "were bought")

o Object: "the concert tickets"

Other options:

• (1) My friend has bought the concert tickets. → Incorrect, as it changes the tense to present perfect.

• (3) My friend buys the concert tickets. → Incorrect, as it changes the tense to simple present.

• (4) My friend is buying the concert tickets. → Incorrect, as it changes the tense to present continuous.
